info.title: MODO Sales Executive Mobile API
info.description: Test the ERP mobile APIs here. First grant the user Mobile App Access in Membership > Users. Login using email/password, or send WhatsApp OTP then verify it. Copy data.token into Authorize (without Bearer), and supply X-Plant-Id for workspace requests. The OTP template is sales_executive_login with one six-digit parameter. Codes expire in five minutes. Swagger does not send requests until you click Execute. Existing module permissions and plant ownership still apply. All mobile roles, including managers and system administrators, can access only their own business records. VIEW_ALL and administrator status do not broaden mobile record ownership. Shared catalogs remain plant-scoped.

post.description: An administrator must grant mobile app access for this email in Membership > Users first. Email/password login returns the bearer token directly. Alternative: Send WhatsApp OTP and Verify OTP. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.

get.description: Requires sales-mobile bearer token and X-Plant-Id. History is scoped to the user and plant. Use the sequential numeric notification ID (push_log_id). Live delivery uses Reverb while connected; FCM/APNs is not implemented. On tap map subject_type + subject_id to the app screen and load the record through its API; record permissions still apply. CrmLead -> GET /leads/{id}; Quotation -> GET /quotations/{id}; SalesOrder -> GET /orders/{id}; CustomerPO -> GET /customer-pos/{id}. There is no public send-test endpoint: create/update a disposable business record with the normal API, with PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED, Reverb and queue worker running. Filter live events by plant_id and refresh history on reconnect. Requires PUSH_NOTIFICATION.RECEIVE to subscribe. Only connect when enabled, configured and can_receive are true. Saves notification_channel; obtain socket_id from a real WebSocket connection before authorizing. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.

post.description: Requires CRM_LEAD.CONVERT and an accessible lead with active mix_design_id. Automatically converts an eligible unconverted lead and creates a linked quotation. Do not send items or mix_design_id: these come from the lead. A previously linked quotation blocks another creation. Select a customer-linked site. Notification behavior: successful CrmLead, Quotation or SalesOrder model creation/business update/deletion generates a notification per eligible recipient. Stale sessions over 24 hours, manual/HR records and payroll conflicts require HR correction. Attendance does not directly send business push notifications. Notification behavior: this request does not directly trigger a business push notification.
